info.title: Klaviyo API
info.description: The Klaviyo REST API. Please visit https://developers.klaviyo.com for more details.

get.description:
Get all templates in an account. Use `additional-fields[template]=definition` to include the full template definition for SYSTEM_DRAGGABLE templates.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `75/s`
Steady: `750/m` **Scopes:** `templates:read` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/stable/apis/get_templates.json)

parameters.name: additional-fields[template]
parameters.description: Request additional fields not included by default in the response. Supported values: 'definition'

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
For more information please visit https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/v2026-10-15/reference/api-overview#filtering
Allowed field(s)/operator(s):
`id`: `any`, `equals` (string)
`name`: `any`, `contains`, `equals` (string)
`created`: `equals`, `greater-or-equal`, `greater-than`, `less-or-equal`, `less-than` (date-time)
`updated`: `equals`, `greater-or-equal`, `greater-than`, `less-or-equal`, `less-than` (date-time)

post.description:
Create a new HTML or drag-and-drop template. If there are 1,000 or more templates in an account, creation will fail as there is a limit of 1,000 templates that can be created via the API. Request specific fields using [sparse fieldsets](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference/api_overview#sparse-fieldsets).

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `75/s`
Steady: `750/m` **Scopes:** `templates:write` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/stable/apis/create_template.json)

get.description:
Get the template conversion jobs created in the last 7 days, newest first.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `75/s`
Steady: `750/m` **Scopes:** `templates:read` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/stable/apis/get_template_conversion_jobs.json)

post.description:
Convert an HTML template into a new drag-and-drop template. The job runs asynchronously. Poll the job until its status is `complete` or `failed`. When complete, `converted-template` is the new template. Rate limited to 1 request per minute. Requires an account on a paid plan; other accounts get a 403.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `1/s`
Steady: `1/m` **Scopes:** `templates:write` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/stable/apis/create_template_conversion_job.json)

requestBody.description: Convert an HTML template into a new drag-and-drop template.

get.description:
Get a template conversion job with the given job ID.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `75/s`
Steady: `750/m` **Scopes:** `templates:read` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/stable/apis/get_template_conversion_job.json)

post.description:
Render a template with the given template ID and context attribute. Returns the AMP, HTML, and plain text versions of the email template. **Request body parameters** (nested under `attributes`): * `return_fields`: Request specific fields using [sparse fieldsets](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference/api_overview#sparse-fieldsets). * `context`: This is the context your email template will be rendered with. You must pass in a `context` object as a JSON object. Email templates are rendered with contexts in a similar manner to Django templates. Nested template variables can be referenced via dot notation. Template variables without corresponding `context` values are treated as `FALSE` and output nothing. Ex. `{ "name" : "George Washington", "state" : "VA" }`

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `3/s`
Steady: `60/m` **Scopes:** `templates:read` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/stable/apis/render_template.json)

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `75/s`
Steady: `750/m` **Scopes:** `templates:write` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/stable/apis/clone_template.json)

Send a test email of a template to one or more recipients.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `1/s`
Steady: `15/m`
Daily: `100/d` **Scopes:** `templates:write` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/stable/apis/create_template_preview_send_job.json)

requestBody.description: Send a test email of a template to the given recipients.

editor_type.description:
`editor_type` has a fixed set of values:
* SYSTEM_DRAGGABLE: indicates a drag-and-drop editor template
* SIMPLE: A rich text editor template
* CODE: A custom HTML template
* USER_DRAGGABLE: A hybrid template, using custom HTML in the drag-and-drop editor

Klaviyo-API-Key.name: Authorization
Klaviyo-API-Key.description:
Private key authentication for /api/ endpoints is performed by setting the `Authorization` header to `Klaviyo-API-Key your-private-api-key`
For more information please visit https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/v2026-10-15/reference/api-overview#authentication
